summary: Item Details tabbed rebuild verified end-to-end on the Expo web preview in the Iron Forge theme as user ryan@ryan.com. All 12 acceptance criteria PASS. (1) Detail screen renders without crash for tool 88e8adbf-…df7b ('Blue Shop Towels'). (2) Top panel shows photo + STATUS/QUANTITY/PRICE EACH pills + a centered location row 'Drawer 1' with the map-pin icon and NO 'Location' label (testID top-location verified, textContent='Drawer 1'). (3) Tab strip is horizontally scrollable with 5 tabs (tab-details, tab-bundle, tab-documents, tab-maintenance, tab-history); active tab is highlighted in accent orange; tapping a tab swaps ONLY the bounded panel below — page itself does not grow. (4) Details view shows MODEL # (75130), SERIAL #, DEALER (Harbor Freight w/ chevron — navigable), BRAND (Scott), PURCHASED (06/13/2026), CATEGORY (Specialty Service), TAGS, CONSUMABLE (Yes), and description (Store/Site/SKU/Reorder notes). (5) Bundle tab shows 'ADD TO A BUNDLE' (testID bundle-add) since this tool isn't bundled. (6) Documents tab renders PHOTOS (with add-photo-btn), DOCUMENTS, RECEIPTS sections. (7) Maintenance tab renders MAINTENANCE + WARRANTY sections. (8) History tab opens a 'VIEW HISTORY' popup with Checkout History + Claim History choices (testIDs history-choice-checkout & history-choice-claims both present); inline history-checkout & history-claims buttons also present in the tab content. (9) EDIT flow works: 3-dots menu → 'Edit item' enters edit mode → bottom CANCEL/SAVE bar appears (edit-cancel-bar & edit-save-bar) → Details edit fields present (edit-brand, edit-model-0, edit-add-model, edit-serial-0, edit-description, edit-category, edit-tags, edit-dealer). Changed BRAND from 'Scott' to 'Scott TEST', tapped SAVE → page returned to view mode and the updated brand 'Scott TEST' is reflected in the rendered Details panel (api.updateTool PUT succeeded). Restored brand back to 'Scott' afterwards. (10) Switching to Maintenance tab while in edit mode shows the inline warranty section with the toggle. (11) No console pageerror, no React Native red screen. Only 401/403 noise (background API calls before login) and the standard Expo-web textShadow*/shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings — unrelated. (12) Known black-screen glitch was hit on initial load; resolved by a single tap to wake the renderer (as documented in the agent-to-agent context note).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/tool/[id].tsx is 3923 lines — far over the 700-line guideline. The new tab content blocks (renderDetailsContent / renderBundleContent / renderDocumentsContent / renderMaintenanceContent / renderHistoryContent + the inline edit form + the modals: location/dealer/category/tags/bundle picker/history choice/poster/list-for-sale/mark-sold/etc.) are all colocated. Strongly recommend extracting each tab body into /app/frontend/src/screens/tool/tabs/*.tsx and each modal into /app/frontend/src/screens/tool/modals/*.tsx behind small props contracts. Not blocking this release, but maintenance risk is high.

Active-tab highlight is correct, but on a 390px viewport the 'Maintenance' tab label is partially clipped at the right edge in the resting state — the strip IS scrollable so users can pan, but consider giving the active tab an autoScrollIntoView on press so the active label is never clipped when the user taps a partially-offscreen tab.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing ryan@ryan.com demo data (16 tools). Brand was temporarily changed to 'Scott TEST' to verify persistence, then restored to 'Scott'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Item Details lives at /app/frontend/app/tool/[id].tsx. The new layout = fixed top panel (photo + 3 pills + centered top-location row) + horizontal tab strip (tab-{details|bundle|documents|maintenance|history}) + a single bounded TbvListPanel that scrolls internally. State to know: activeTab, editing, form, showEditDealer/Category/Tags/Location, showBundlePicker, showHistoryChoice. The 3-dots 'Edit item' (testID menu-edit) calls beginEdit() and flips Details + Maintenance tabs into editable fields with a bottom CANCEL/SAVE bar (edit-cancel-bar / edit-save-bar). History stays view-only; tapping tab-history opens the choice popup AND the tab body shows inline history-checkout / history-claims buttons. Web preview occasionally renders a black screen — a single mouse click on the page wakes it up (already handled in test scripts). Login testIDs: auth-email, auth-password, auth-submit. Use tool id 88e8adbf-be58-4114-8a0e-76fe2e93df7b ('Blue Shop Towels') as the canonical fixture — it has dealer + category + consumable + description so every Details row is populated.
